target_customer: B2B companies and their executives who want LinkedIn content that drives pipeline
problem: B2B teams lack data-driven LinkedIn content; the agent decides what to post from engagement data, drafts and schedules posts and maps engagement to pipeline.
product_category: AI content agent for LinkedIn / B2B marketing

founders.name: Sky Yang
founders.background_notes: YC page: founded nonprofit Break the Outbreak.

founders.name: Neo Lee
prior_employers: founding engineer at MiraclePlus, Mysten Labs and SUI Foundation backed startups

technical_complexity.rationale: LLM drafting and scheduling over LinkedIn data; the data graph of 1M+ profiles is the harder part and its provenance is not described.

defensibility.rationale: Claimed engagement data on 1M+ people could compound, but unverified; content tools are easy to copy.

market_need_then: Company claims 50+ B2B customers and $40M customer-generated revenue; earlier launches cited $31M and $10M, so figures are inconsistent and unverified.

brand_strength.rationale: Very generic 'Imagine AI' name collides with other AI products; no brand press found.

outcome_analysis: Imagine AI is a Fall 2025 YC company selling a LinkedIn content agent to B2B teams, with self-reported traction that is inconsistent across launches. No verified funding or outcome exists yet, and the generic name and crowded LinkedIn tool market are visible risks.
notes: Aggregators give conflicting funding ($500K pre-seed, Jan 2025 seed, convertible note); unverified so not recorded as rounds. Investors named by one aggregator: Pelion Venture Partners, Founders Inc, Blast Club. No dated competitors from 2025 found; Taplio, AuthoredUp, Supergrow results were 2026 vendor comparisons. Traction numbers are company-reported. The pre-seed rests on a single database (VCBacked, also FundedIQ); another outlet reports a $130,000 seed at YC acceptance, which conflicts and is not recorded.
